description: QHora-301W layout v2 (docs/design.md, draft 4). 1 MiB aligned, standard 128-entry GPT. Each slot holds its FIT plus that slot's overlay (fitblk maps the space after the FIT as /dev/fitrw, which fstools uses as rootfs_data); 'data' is shared general storage, not an overlay. Partition GUIDs are generated per unit at install time.
